title: Inter: Carlos Augusto is not a backup any more - Gazzetta says a deal to 2031
caption:
Inter's Carlos Augusto scored the only goal against Shakhtar Donetsk on Wednesday, and per Gazzetta dello Sport his contract should be extended to 2031 inside fifteen days - pay rising from EUR 2.2M to EUR 3.5M plus bonuses. Corriere dello Sport is less definite and gives the club about a month. Reported by the papers, not announced by the club. Fiorentina at San Siro on Sunday, 7:30 AM ET.
